title: A teleprompter that waits for you
pin_title: A Teleprompter App That Waits for You: Cue (No Watermark)
desc: Cue keeps your script close to the camera so your eyes stay on the lens. Unlimited scripts, steady scrolling, mirror mode and recording with no watermark are free. Optional Cue Plus adds Voice Pace, which scrolls while you talk and waits when you pause. Now on Android.

title: Read your script and keep eye contact
pin_title: How to Read a Script on Camera and Still Keep Eye Contact
desc: Put your script right under the camera with Cue, pick a comfortable text size and speed, and record your take with no watermark. Great for Reels, TikToks, YouTube intros and presentations. Free teleprompter app on Android.
